name: browser-use
description: Official Browser Use MCP server. The hosted server runs browser agent tasks on Browser Use Cloud stealth browsers with residential proxies and CAPTCHA solving; the local stdio server runs the open-source browser-use agent on your machine.

BROWSER_USE_API_KEY.description: Browser Use Cloud API key for the hosted server. Get one at https://cloud.browser-use.com/settings. Never commit your key. Tasks use account credits.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: LLM API key for the local stdio server only.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP on Browser Use Cloud. Uses account credits.

uvx.description: Local stdio server from the open-source browser-use package. Requires your own LLM API key.

examples.title: Run a browser task
examples.description: Run a browser agent task in a cloud browser
examples.prompt: Use browser-use to open https://news.ycombinator.com and return the top 5 story titles.
